```yaml
name: Copilot SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '1.21'

    - name: Extract Copilot version from constants.go
      id: extract_version
      run: |
        VERSION=$(grep -o 'DefaultCopilotVersion.*=.*"[^"]*"' pkg/constants/constants.go | cut -d'"' -f2)
        echo "copilot_version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '24'
        cache: 'npm'
        cache-dependency-path: copilot-client/package-lock.json

    - name: Install copilot-client dependencies
      working-directory: copilot-client
      run: npm ci

    - name: Build copilot-client
      working-directory: copilot-client
      run: npm run build

    - name: Run copilot-client tests
      working-directory: copilot-client
      run: npm test

    - name: Run integration tests
      working-directory: copilot-client
      env:
        COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: |
        # Test basic functionality
        echo '{"prompt":"Hello world","maxTokens":100}' | node dist/cli.js
```
